title: InfoSec Assurance platform feedback record
description: One feedback record about an agent output, a pipeline run or an advisory answer. Written by humans (portal thumbs export, Teams form, MCP client, SharePoint list {list:PlatformFeedback}) and by exports of platform signals (human-evaluation templates, continuous evaluation, verifier outcomes, approval decisions). Consumed offline by enterprise/memory/learning_loop.py. Rules: no report content, findings, scores, supplier confidential text or personal data beyond the submitter's UPN placeholder; identifiers only (run id, conversation id, agent, pipeline). Retention 24 months. See enterprise/MEMORY_AND_LEARNING.md section 4 and 6.

id.description: fb-{yyyymmdd}-{8 hex}; assigned by the collector

source.description: user_feedback = written by a team member; end_user_thumbs = gen_ai.evaluation.result events (preview); human_eval_template = reviewer answers in the agent Preview app (preview); continuous_evaluation = sampled evaluator scores (GA core); golden_set_eval = operations/evaluation/run_evals.py case below floor; verifier_fail = output-verifier FAIL finding; approval_rework = edit/rejection in {list:ApprovalDecisions}; ai_concern = ISO 42001 A.8.3 / EU AI Act Art. 26(7) concern (mandatory item)

submitted_by.description: Placeholder UPN of the human, or {system:<collector>} for exported platform signals

agent.description: Agent name as in integrations/registry.json (e.g. dora, deepsearch-protocol, infosec-assurance-advisor, output-verifier)

agent_version.description: Immutable agent version that produced the output (<name>:<version>), when known

pipeline.description: Entry of workflows/pipelines.json (e.g. deepsearch-report, dpia-dpo-report) or null for advisory answers

run_id.description: Logic Apps run id or evaluation run id — identifiers only

category.description: Drives the change path chosen by learning_loop.py (see enterprise/memory/learning_loop.py CATEGORY_TO_CHANGE)

signal.description: The measurable part. At least one of rating, thumbs, metric or verdict must be present

metric.description: Evaluator or golden-set metric name (groundedness, relevance, task_adherence, tool_call_accuracy, verifier_first_pass, ...)

finding_code.description: Verifier rule id or rejection reason code — never the finding text about a supplier

description.description: What was wrong or good, in generic terms. Must not contain supplier confidential content, findings, scores, personal data, hostnames, credentials

ai_concern.description: true = bias, wrong regulatory claim, hallucinated citation or suspected injection; mandatory backlog item, acknowledged the same day (CONTINUOUS_IMPROVEMENT.md S15)

invariant_touched.description: Set when the feedback suggests an invariant was or could be weakened; such items are never 'improvements' — they go to incident/risk-acceptance handling

evidence_refs.description: Run ids, trace ids, eval-report paths, ticket ids. No URLs to supplier documents

triage.description: Filled by the owner (deputy when the owner submitted) — never by an agent

retain_until.description: timestamp + 24 months; the collector purges after this date

examples.description: Answer cited an RTS article number that does not exist in the cited regulation; correct article was one number higher.
examples.expected: Citation resolves to the published article

examples.description: Required section missing on first pass; passed after regeneration.
